- FCA SYSC 6.1 applies to MiFID optional‑exemption firms and third‑country firms “as if they were rules or as guidance in accordance with SYSC 1 Annex 1 3.2CR(1)” and requires them to establish, implement and maintain adequate policies and procedures to ensure compliance with the regulatory system and counter financial‑crime risk, including for MiFID‑related activities [2].  
- PRA Rulebook (Compliance and Internal Audit) Part 1.1 applies to a CRR firm “with respect to the carrying on of … in relation to MiFID business, ancillary services” and requires the firm to establish, implement and maintain adequate policies and procedures sufficient to ensure compliance with the regulatory system and to counter financial‑crime risk for MiFID‑related activities [8].
